status: unreleased candidate; proposed settings remain unapplied

measurement_boundaries.host: Linux arm64, Neoverse-N1, 3 logical CPUs, Node 24.18.0
measurement_boundaries.http: Request/response body bytes; excludes headers and TLS; local services without injected WAN delay or loss
measurement_boundaries.p2p: Host RTCDataChannel payload; includes RPC controls and application retries; excludes signalling, lower-layer headers, and lower-layer retries
measurement_boundaries.elapsed: CLI process elapsed; excludes prior file mirroring and subsequent digest verification; P2P includes discovery and connection
measurement_boundaries.cloudant: Local CouchDB constraint model and synthetic boundary probes; no IBM service benchmark

assumptions.batch_processing: serial; Couch changes feed may overlap
assumptions.observed_payload_proxy: body bytes held constant when batch_size changes; envelope overhead not recalculated
assumptions.couch_mixed_range: overlapped versus serial independent-direction references, not guaranteed bounds; echo may add work
assumptions.p2p_mixed: old local rows precede imported echo rows; target revision comparison suppresses echo bodies
assumptions.p2p_direction: sync() initiator viewpoint; pull-only watchers use the separate one-way pull column
